title: Information-Matched Auditing of Conversational Emotion-Shift Forecasting: A Leakage-Safe Evaluation Protocol
abstract: arXiv:2611.05895v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Comparisons in conversational emotion-shift forecasting are easily distorted when a learned model receives rich features but its transition baseline is given a noisy or unavailable current-emotion label, when hyperparameter budgets differ, or when target-turn information enters the representation. We present an information-matched, leakage-safe auditing protocol that closes these gaps with an explicit commitment point, executable causality tests, equal four-configuration validation searches, and seed-dialogue-aware inference. Applying it to six causal model families on four text corpora and two feature-source sensitivity configurations shows that a deployable train-only current-emotion classifier feeding the transition baseline yields a different verdict than an oracle diagnostic where both sides receive gold current emotion. translated_title: 对话情绪转变预测的信息匹配审计：一种防泄漏的评估协议
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.05895v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：在对话情绪转变预测研究中，当学习型模型获得丰富的特征，而其转移基线却被给予含噪声或不可获得的当前情绪标签时，当超参数预算不相同时，或当目标轮次信息混入表示中时，比较结果很容易被扭曲。我们提出了一种信息匹配且防泄漏的审计协议，通过明确的承诺点、可执行的因果性测试、均等的四配置验证搜索以及感知种子对话的推理来消除这些差距。将该协议应用于四个文本语料库和两种特征源敏感性配置上的六个因果模型族，结果表明：当为转移基线提供一个仅基于训练数据且可部署的当前情绪分类器时，所得到的评估结论与双方均获得金标准当前情绪的先知式诊断所得出的结论不同。在可部署条件下，学习型模型在全部四个主要语料库上均优于预测标签基线（摘要在此处被截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种信息匹配、防泄漏的对话情绪转变预测审计协议，通过明确的承诺点与可执行的因果性测试，揭示了可部署条件与先知式诊断条件会得出不同的评估结论。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an information-matched, leakage-safe auditing protocol with an explicit commitment point and executable causality tests, showing that evaluation verdicts for conversational emotion-shift forecasting differ between deployable conditions and oracle diagnostics.
